newsitem.title: USA: Baxter, Sorin to team on heart valve.
newsitem.headline: Baxter, Sorin to team on heart valve.

text.p: Baxter Healthcare Corp said on Wednesday that it agreed with Sorin Biomedica SpA to collaborate on a mechanical heart valve.
The bileaflet valve, based on an existing Sorin product cleared for commercial sale in some countries, will be made by Sorin and marketed by Baxter, Baxter said in a statement.
It will feature a low-profile design that should make it suitable for minimally invasive heart valve implant techniques and offer an alternative to tissue valve therapies, Baxter said.

"Although many surgeons prefer the performance and clinical profile of tissue value therapies, we recognize that some patients will be indicated for mechanical products and our commitment is to offer clinicians the very best solutions to meet their needs," Michael Mussallem, group vice president of Baxter Healthcare, said in the statement.

"The new product allows Baxter to provide the most complete line of mechanical, tissue and repair products worldwide and complements our portfolio of technologies designed to manage late-stage cardiovascular disease,"he said.
Baxter makes tissue valve replacement and repair products. Sorin has strengths in mechanical valves, Baxter said.
Baxter plans to offer the new valve commercially in key overseas markets in 1997, while simultaneously launching U.S. clinical trials.

Baxter also said it will continue to explore opportunities with other potential partners for technologies for treating late- stage cardiovascular disease. Baxter Healthcare is Baxter International Inc's principle U.S. unit. Through its subsidiaries, Baxter also has products for transfusion medicine, intravenous medication delivery and kidney disease.
